texts:
Your avatar has a wardrobe now.

59 pieces so far: jackets, jeans, hair, glasses. Each one is a rigged 3D garment, not a texture painted on a body, and it binds to any humanoid avatar at the moment you put it on. No fixed skeleton to match.

Open a piece in 3D and turn it around before you wear it.

When nothing in the catalog fits, describe the garment in a sentence. The forge builds the mesh, rigs it, validates it, and publishes it to the catalog in about seven minutes, where anyone can wear it.
